class.name: LaserDebugLayer2D
class.description: Created by [BulletFactory2D] as an internal, owner-less child while [member BulletFactory2D.is_debugger_enabled] is on and lasers exist: it draws every box the active lasers' contact queries test (see [method BulletFactory2D.debug_get_laser_debug_boxes]). Never saved; a script freeing it gets a new one at the next tick.
